extras: Scripts run with full plugin permissions, but execution is consent-gated and includes a per-script kill-switch.
intentEvidence: Reshape pasted or whole-note Markdown to fit a note's structure — heading cascade, footnote renumbering and dedup — plus a runnable, consent-gated script library.
problem: When importing content from LLMs or web sources, headings often don't match the target note's structure, and citation numbers frequently collide with existing footnotes.

relations.evidence: Copy some text, place your cursor, and run Markdown Mason: Paste and run scripts from the command palette.

summary: Markdown Mason reshapes pasted or whole-note Markdown to fit a note's structure, handling heading cascades and footnote renumbering, and provides a runnable script library.
